description: Decode a JSON Web Token (a leading "Bearer " is fine): header, payload, iat/nbf/exp/auth_time as ISO dates with relative time, expired / not-yet-valid status, and named standard claims. If "secret" is given, verifies HS256/HS384/HS512 signatures (secret as text or Base64URL). RS/ES/PS tokens are decoded but not verified (needs a public key). Encrypted JWE tokens can't be read. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/jwt-inspector/

now.description: Unix time in seconds to judge expiry against. Default: now.

secret.description: HMAC secret to verify an HS256/384/512 signature.

secretIsBase64.description: The secret is Base64/Base64URL-encoded bytes, not text.

name: jwt_decode
title: JWT decode
